name: House
overview: Scripture reveals the house as both a physical and spiritual refuge, constructed with intentional materials and care, as seen when the people made bricks for building (Genesis 11:3) and Joseph sought solitude in his chamber to weep (Genesis 43:30). Houses served practical and communal purposes, from the treasure cities built under Egyptian bondage (Exodus 1:11) to the regulation of buying and redeeming homes within walled cities (Leviticus 25:29). The spiritual significance of the house is underscored by the command to write God's words on the posts and gates of the house (Deuteronomy 6:9), highlighting the home as a place of worship and instruction.
